assertions.text: Asks one question per vendor (in one AskUserQuestion call), each quoting that vendor's recipient, model and reach
Each question states the batches' target paths, the dispatch count and that the diff leaves the machine, and repeats the DISPATCHER_TOUCHED disclosure
Real dispatches pass the dry run's model as --model
A changed dispatcher at the re-check drops agy for the run with the reason; the earlier locator result is not used
